Container.Name: homelab-health
Container.Overview: Self-hosted health monitor for your homelab services. Runs pluggable checks (HTTP, TCP, Frigate per-camera, and services exposing the JSON /health contract) on a schedule with debounce, reducing each service to Ok / Degraded / Critical / Unknown with per-component detail. Current status is exposed as a JSON API at /api/v1/status. Monitors are managed entirely through the REST API at /api/v1/monitors; the SQLite database persists in /data.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the health monitor HTTP API (the container always listens on 8080 internally)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (health.db)
